title: Birthday reward
description: Send loyalty members a birthday treat that can be redeemed in store or online. Birthday reward WhatsApp template for retail.
notes: Birthday offers have strong open rates. State the validity window clearly and how to redeem it.

body.text: Happy birthday, {{first_name}}! As a thank you, enjoy a *{{reward}}* to use on anything in store or online until {{date}}. Thank you, and reply here if you need anything.
